lead.tldr: TRM Labs hits $1 billion valuation with $70 million raise, boosting blockchain forensics for compliance. • SEC guidance structures RWA disclosures, aiding tokenized asset compliance and investor clarity. • Tian Ruixiang takes 15,000 Bitcoin for equity, signaling rising corporate Bitcoin adoption. • Vitalik pushes Ethereum native rollups, shifting scaling strategy from dominant L2 reliance.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The crypto landscape is evolving rapidly as regulatory clarity accelerates institutional adoption, with the SEC providing much-needed guidance on digital asset disclosures while security innovations like blockchain analytics continue strengthening the ecosystem's integrity. Meanwhile, strategic capital deployment remains critical as investors navigate market volatility, with opportunities emerging across Bitcoin investments, climate tech, and Web3 infrastructure for those positioned to capitalize on this transformative moment.

top_signals.title: Crypto crime-fighting startup TRM Labs notches $1 billion valuation with new $70 million funding round
top_signals.summary: TRM Labs, a leading provider of blockchain analytics tools for detecting and investigating crypto-related crimes, raised $70 million in funding to reach a $1 billion valuation. The platform enables financial institutions, law enforcement agencies like the FBI, and crypto businesses to trace illicit funds across blockchains, identify real-world entities behind addresses, and generate court-ready evidence. This milestone underscores growing institutional demand for reliable blockchain intelligence amid rising crypto fraud, ransomware, and sanctions evasion risks. For institutional investors, TRM's expansion signals a maturing compliance infrastructure essential for scaling crypto asset management while meeting AML/CFT standards.

top_signals.title: RWA.xyz Blog - The SEC Has Logged On: Crypto Disclosure Enters the Mempool
top_signals.summary: The SEC has released guidance clarifying how traditional securities disclosure obligations apply to digital assets and tokenized ecosystems. This provides structure for the crypto industry.

top_signals.title: Tian Ruixiang Says Investor to Contribute 15,000 Bitcoin for Equity
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq-listed insurance brokerage Tian Ruixiang announced that an investor will contribute 15,000 Bitcoin in exchange for equity in the company. This represents a significant investment in the company and could signal growing institutional interest in Bitcoin.

top_signals.title: Galaxy Digital reports $482m loss as Bitcoin price takes a beating
top_signals.summary: Galaxy Digital reported a $241 million net loss in Q4 2025, contributing to a $482 million loss overall. The losses are attributed to unrealized losses on digital asset holdings, though CEO Mike Novogratz remains optimistic about future price recovery.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Eventbrite cofounder launches new €250m climate fund
top_signals.summary: Eventbrite cofounder Renaud Visage launches a new €250m climate fund. Visage believes the climate tech downturn presents an opportunity for investors.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin Says Ethereum Scaling Should Move From L2s
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin suggests Ethereum scaling should shift focus towards native rollups on the mainnet, implying a potential change in strategy from relying solely on Layer 2 solutions.
